mentions.heading: Vehicle manufacturer cybersecurity, data privacy and data localization obligations
mentions.detail: Vehicle-maker-specific cybersecurity and data localization rules abroad; risks of audits, investigations, mandated disclosure of sensitive data
mentions.quote: In addition to the risks related to general privacy regulation, we may also be subject to specific vehicle manufacturer obligations relating to cybersecurity, data privacy and data localization requirements which place additional risks to our international operations.

mentions.heading: Data breach of customer personal information
mentions.detail: Generic statement; costs to comply with data breach requirements if customer personal information is improperly obtained
mentions.quote: Notwithstanding our efforts to protect the security and integrity of our customers’ personal information, we may be required to expend significant resources to comply with data breach requirements if, for example, third parties improperly obtain and use the personal information of our customers or we otherwise experience a data loss with respect to the personal information we process and handle.
